name: error-summary
title: Error Summary
description: A summary that takes focus on submit, links each error to its field, and ticks items off live as they are fixed, plus a useFormErrors() hook.

meta.stops: Users miss errors on long forms
meta.summary: A GOV.UK-style error summary that takes focus on submit, links each error to its field and ticks errors off as they are fixed.
catches: Errors missed on long forms, listed in one place on submit
Finding the field, by linking each error to it
Progress, by ticking off fixed errors live
limits: Lists the errors you pass; validation is up to you
Linking to a field needs the field's id to match the error item
a11y: Takes focus on submit (tabIndex=-1) and is labelled by its title
Each link moves focus to its field
Fixed items say "Fixed:" in text; progress changes are aria-live="polite"
